Make sure the adapter for Display to HDMI is indicated to be Active, not Passive. Also, it has to support the level of HDMI compliance you're looking for. Same goes for the Display Port device itself - It needs to be Display Port 1.2.

So like are you looking to output 4k, then you need an HDMI 1.4 adapter and compatible display and if you're looking to do 4k@60, you'll need at least HDMI 2.0. The cable, as well, has to meet or exceed the HDMI display you're hoping to drive. A cheap, old cable won't push 4k at 30 or 60hz. It will not push 18gbs

For example:
